description: Tests labware management features added in the labware refactoring: official Opentrons labware list scanning (ot2_scan_available_labware tool) and deck configuration using Opentrons load names. The ot2_scan_available_labware tool reads opentrons_labware_official.txt and scans the LABWARE_PATH directory for custom JSON definitions.

scenarios.name: List available official Opentrons labware
scenarios.description: Agent uses ot2_scan_available_labware to list the official Opentrons labware names from opentrons_labware_official.txt.
scenarios.prompt: What official Opentrons labware options are available? Use the scan_available_labware tool and list the standard labware IDs I can use in my settings.toml configuration.

scenarios.name: Scan custom labware directory
scenarios.description: Agent scans the configured custom labware directory (LABWARE_PATH env variable) for available JSON labware definitions using ot2_scan_available_labware.
scenarios.prompt: Scan all available labware using the scan_available_labware tool. List both the official Opentrons labware and any custom labware JSON files available.

scenarios.name: Find 384-well plates in labware catalog
scenarios.description: User asks about 384-well plate options. Agent should use ot2_scan_available_labware and filter for 384-well plates.
scenarios.prompt: What 384-well plate options are available in the Opentrons labware library? I need to choose one for my destination plate. Use scan_available_labware to find out.

scenarios.name: Look up and configure labware for deck slot
scenarios.description: User wants to configure a specific labware type in settings.toml. Agent should scan for available options and then configure the correct Opentrons labware ID in settings.
scenarios.prompt: I want to use a Corning 96-well flat bottom plate in slot 4. Use scan_available_labware to find the correct Opentrons labware ID, then configure it in slot 4 as a reservoir type using update_settings.

scenarios.name: Read offset database resource
scenarios.description: Agent reads the get_offsets resource to show currently saved calibration offsets.
multi_turn: Use add_labware_definition to save an offset for labware 'nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat' in slot '4' with offset_x=-0.5, offset_y=0.8, offset_z=-0.3.
Now read the get_offsets resource (config://offsets) to show me all currently saved calibration offsets.

scenarios.name: Scan labware and calibrate found plate
scenarios.description: Combined workflow: agent scans for labware, finds a specific plate, then saves its calibration offset.
multi_turn: Use ot2_scan_available_labware to scan available labware and find a BioRad 96-well PCR plate. Report the exact labware ID.
Now save a calibration offset for the BioRad 96-well PCR plate (use the exact labware_id from scan results) in slot 2 with offset_x=-0.2, offset_y=0.4, offset_z=-0.1 using add_labware_definition.
